_provenance: Generated by scripts/build-demo-hall-shapes.ts from T_EVENT_HALL_LAYOUT_DATA.csv. Per hall, the CSV row with the most nonClickableAreas was converted to centre-origin coordinates (posX = x + w/2 - W/2, posZ = y + h/2 - L/2; W = csv length, L = csv breadth). Colour mapping: #ffffff -> outside, #742371 -> wall, else zone. No production system was read or written.
